relationships.subject: Dync1i1
relationships.evidence_quote: Nociception of mechanical, thermal, and cold pain in Dync1i1<sup>-/-</sup> mice were impaired.

relationships.subject: S1 parvalbumin interneurons
relationships.evidence_quote: This neuronal dysfunction was rescued by optogenetic activation of PV neurons in Dync1i1<sup>-/-</sup> mice, and mimicked by suppressing PV neurons using chemogenetics in WT mice.

relationships.subject: Dync1i1
relationships.evidence_quote: The activities of parvalbumin (PV) interneurons and gamma oscillation in primary somatosensory were also impaired when exposed to mechanical nociceptive stimulation.

relationships.subject: S1 gamma oscillation
relationships.evidence_quote: Impaired pain sensations in Dync1i1<sup>-/-</sup> mice were correlated with impaired gamma oscillations due to a loss of interneurons, especially the PV type.

key_findings: Dync1i1 knockout mice show impaired mechanical, thermal and cold nociception with impaired S1 PV interneuron activity and gamma oscillations.
Optogenetic activation of PV neurons rescued the S1 dysfunction in knockouts, while chemogenetic PV suppression mimicked it in WT mice.
